title: At the gate
steps: You are at the gate, and you do not know how to open it.
Hello? Is anyone there? Can someone let me in?
Someone else is coming up the path: another new pupil, out of breath.
Hi there! I am {friend}, a first-year pupil, and I am just arriving too.
Nice to meet you! I am {wizard}. Do you happen to know how this gate opens?
My parents are not wizards, so I know nothing of magic.
A wizard born to parents without magic is extremely rare, a thing to be proud of! My parents are wizards and have taught me some things, so I can teach you the basics.
I grew up among wizards, so I know a little magic. You do not open this gate by pushing, because it listens to instructions.
What exactly is an instruction? And how do I give an instruction to a gate?
In Arvelia, you try, you watch what happens, and you try again. But let me show you the most important things from the beginning.
